notes.content:

Good evening everyone, here follows a short message from us at Visiontrick Media. 

Together with 3 other independent developers - brought together by The Indie Mega Booth network - we would like to offer you, during a limited time, these 4 artful, serene, offbeat puzzlers:
[b][list]
[*]PAVILION
[*]BACK TO BED
[*]SHE REMEMBERED CATERPILLARS 
[*]THE BRIDGE[/list][/b]All bundled together with a [b]50% discount![/b]

So head over to the bundle page to check out the package!  https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/7233/Artful_Puzzlers/

notes.title: Mouse controls and extras - v1.31
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/16891166/6b0eef0bd322feeee5c7e7a80eca2fb8a8e27593.jpg[/img]

Hi there, a new update from the snow-clad Visiontrick HQ has now been published.

This has been long overdue, but the mouse controls are finally here! Just head into the options meny and toggle it on(you can now choose between 3 options - gamepad/keyboard - mouse - Tobii Eyetracker).

Since it has not been tested to the extents of the gamepad/keyboard version, we appreciate that if you play the game with mouse controls do please get back to us with any information about bugs or strange behavior, or any thoughts of improvements.

A while back we also put in some extras in the game folder but did not write about it here. So located in the game folder, you'll find it through right clicking on the game in the Steam library list -> PROPERTIES -> LOCAL FILES -> BROWES LOCAL FILES. There you will find a Extras folder including:
[list]
[*] "The Early and Unseen Art of PAVILION" PDF.
[*] High-definition wallpapers.
[*] Sample song of Tony Gerbers Soundtrack.
[/list]

There's also a bunch of bug fixes as well as an updated version of the Tobii EyeX firmware(2.0) working with the newly released 4C hardware.

If you have any feedback, please get in touch!

notes.title: Pavilion Eye-tracker - v1.2
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/16891166/5b4a039fd8ac5db5aaf054c6680c62c61d305335.jpg[/img]

As we have mentioned before we’ve teamed up with fellow Swedish company Tobii in order to deliver a version of Pavilion that, with the help of the Tobii EyeX Eye-Tracker device, you can play with your eyes as the only input!

It’s a completely different way to play the game – requiring neither gamepad or keyboard you move around the world by gazing at the direction you want the camera to move, interacting by focusing your gaze on a specific object you want to engage with. It is frankly hard to make it justice by words only and even if you grasp the fundamental way of interacting, when you’re actually there, playing the game with only your gaze it’s a completely different experience that borders on the unreal.

So to find out more about Tobii, how to get your hands on a Eye-Tracker, and Pavilion with Eye-Tracker head over to [url=https://tobiigaming.com/games/pavilion/?utm_source=steam&utm_campaign=pavilion&utm_medium=link]Pavilion on Tobii[/url] and don’t forget to download the latest update of Pavilion here on STEAM in order to activate the Eye-Tracker support in the options menu.

Take care people!

notes.title: Patch v1.12 is live!
notes.content:
Hey,

It's now been a week since the release and we're now working hard on a couple of things that's been requested by multiple people.

The two major feedback points we've gotten is the lack of mouse-controls as well as options. Reason for lack of mouse-controls explained in the following post: http://steamcommunity.com/id/workshophatemachine/recommended/417150/ 

Unfortunately neither  is in this update, but we assure you that we're working on it for the next version.

As for this update , v1.12, the following things have been updated:[list]
[*]Added WASD to keyboard controls.
[*]Added start button binding for gamepads.
[*]Default quality setting is now set as "fantastic"(fixing low-res menu and v-sync problems).
[*]Fixed apartment #2 fade bug.
[*]Fixed wrong z-depth on "upper" tiles in last puzzle of left mansion.
[*]Fixed "push through fence" bug on underground push #2.
[*]Puzzle timing tweaks on #1 puzzle on train station and #3 puzzle on garden.
[*]Added Nordic Game Program and Unity3D logos in credits.[/list]
Thanks for your support and please let us know if you have any feedback!

notes.title: Pavilion Chapter 1 - Music Trailer
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=So_y2jky33Y
As it’s only a couple of days left until the release of Pavilion we thought we wanted to shed some more light on the music of the game. Every since we showcased Pavilion for the first time the reception of the music have been great and people seems to appreciate how the ambient tunes encourage you to plunge into the world and puzzles of Pavilion in a kind of meditative state.

With that said here’s some words from the musician – Tony Gerber – and a video showcasing some of the music together with a couple of dreamlike landscapes from the game itself.

“The Pavilion project came to me in perhaps the perfect way. Visiontrick Media’s had been using my music as their listening backdrop during the initial creation of the game’s amazing art and programming. When it came time for them to start thinking about the game’s actual music, they could think of only my music. For this reason, the game and soundtrack are entwined in a unique way.

The soundtrack includes a variety from my musical catalog as well as some new themes and textures. A full length recording of the music of Pavilion is available September 22nd as a high quality file download via Steam and other outlets. A physical CD version will be available too.”
–Tony Gerber 
http://tonygerber.com

notes.title: Pavilion Chapter 1 - Coming September 22nd
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RMwoOcjWyJc It ONLY took us a little over 4 years, but we are finally here.

As it often does, the planned schedule goes out the window and you start chasing the shadow of a new possible release date. We did this for a long time, pushing the date of the release further and further up ahead. Going through that last door towards release just to discover… another door.

Especially the past year, trying to nail down the release date, has been grueling. We probably had a hundred reasons to give up and just call it quits. But thanks to the support of friends and family together with our own stubbornness and the conviction that Pavilion could bring something unique, we stuck with it and followed it through. Now we are standing in a doorway and there are no more doors.

So Chapter 1 of Pavilion will be out September 22nd here on STEAM. So please share this with your friends and people who might be interested in Pavilion and you'll have our deepest gratitude!

Hope you’ll enjoy it and thanks for the support throughout the years.
We wish you all the best. – Henrik & Rickard.

*Full release announcement: http://www.visiontrick.com/blog/pavilion-release-announcement/
